build_dataset_train: build a training ImageFolder dataset from a data path with augmentation transforms using build_dataset
build_dataset_val: build a validation ImageFolder dataset from a data path with eval transforms using build_dataset
build_transform_train: build a training transform pipeline with color jitter and auto augmentation using build_transform
build_transform_eval: build an evaluation transform pipeline with resize, center crop, and normalization using build_transform
refactor_build_dataset: refactor build_dataset to support custom dataset classes instead of torchvision ImageFolder
